user.title: Robotix Home Intelligence - Energy Module
user.description: Add the Energy module. Foundation must be installed and configured before Energy can activate its domain runtime.

abort.single_instance_allowed: The Energy Module is already configured. Open the existing Robotix Home Intelligence - Energy Module integration instead of adding a second instance.

init.title: Energy settings
init.description: Choose what you want to configure. Technical source selection stays in Foundation; these settings control Energy product behaviour.

pricing.title: Energy settings › Pricing & tariffs
pricing.description: Configure only the retail components that are not supplied by a live price source. Leaving all tariff components empty keeps valid market-only accounting.

strategy.title: Energy settings › Strategy & priorities
strategy.description: Choose the part of the Energy strategy you want to configure.

home.title: Energy settings › Strategy › Home & priorities
home.description: Set how actively Energy may operate and what the home should optimise for.

battery.title: Energy settings › Strategy › Battery
battery.description: Configure how the home battery participates in optimisation. Reserve is the minimum state of charge Energy should protect.

solar.title: Energy settings › Strategy › Solar
solar.description: Configure how solar production should be prioritised and how surplus should be used.

grid.title: Energy settings › Strategy › Grid
grid.description: Configure when grid energy may support the home battery and flexible loads.

ev_charging.title: Energy settings › Strategy › EV charging
ev_charging.description: Configure how flexible EV charging should use price, solar, battery and surplus energy.

resilience.title: Energy settings › Strategy › Resilience
resilience.description: Configure how Energy protects backup capacity and responds when resilience is prioritised.

metering.title: Energy settings › Metering view
metering.description: Choose the default period used for Energy metering and value views.

planner.title: Planning optimizer
planner.description: Choose how RHI Energy calculates the plan. RHI manages all sources, equipment, parameters, strategy and safety automatically.

error.invalid_configuration: The setting could not be saved. Check the selected values and try again.
error.canonical_runtime_unavailable: Energy runtime is not available. Reload the integration and try again.
error.emhass_activation_not_yet_supported: EMHASS cannot be selected as primary until native optimization and safety validation pass.
error.invalid_url: Enter a valid EMHASS HTTP(S) service URL.

abort.canonical_configuration_unavailable: Energy configuration is not available yet. Wait until the Energy runtime is ready and open Configure again.
